create_Lab: create a DeepMind Lab environment implementing the dm_env API with a specified level and observation names
create_Lab_reset: reset the DeepMind Lab environment and return a dm_env restart with initial observations
create_Lab_step: step the DeepMind Lab environment with an action dict and return a transition or termination
create_Lab_action_spec: get the action specification dictionary mapping action names to BoundedArray specs
create_Lab_observation_spec: get the observation specification dictionary mapping observation names to Array specs
